newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Pacific Retail maintains strong ytd profit.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Retail maintains strong ytd profit.

text.p: New Zealand appliance and computer retailer Pacific Retail said on Wednesday it had maintained pre-tax profits at about NZ$1 million a month in the four months to the end of July.

"That is an encouraging turnaround from the $340,000 earned before tax in all of the December quarter last year," managing director Greg Lancaster told the company's annual general meeting in Wellington.
He said that after satisfactory trading throughout June and most of July, he stood by his forecast made in May of a pre-tax operating profit of about $6 million in the six months to September 30.

"Market conditions permitting, that pattern of profitability should be maintained into the second half of the financial year, even though the second half is traditionally more difficult than the first," Lancaster said.
Pacific Retail posted a $3.8 million pre-tax profit in the year ending March 31. Its $2.3 million tax paid annual profit compared with a $2.1 million profit the previous year.
Lancaster said Pacific Retail's strategy was to hold down operating costs and improve margins in what remained a difficult retailing market.
